CommunityApplications.Profile: Multi-Coin Paper Daytrader is a paper-only crypto trading simulator for Unraid. It compares long-only and long/short strategies across BTC-EUR, ETH-EUR, SOL-EUR, XRP-EUR and ADA-EUR using shared portfolio risk controls. It starts safely with deterministic demo data and can optionally read current Bitpanda Fusion market data with a Read-only API key. The application cannot place real-money orders. Support and issue tracking are available in the project repository.
